########################################################################################
########################################################################################
The above steps in the section of KSI were done to create a new dataset called ksi_cal_cl (will be read as "ksi_cal" below), 
which is the KSI collisions in Calgary from 2019 to 2024, with the nearest center line road segment's attributes joined to it. 
Now we can read this file and continue with the analysis. Thus, to save time in running the codes, I commented out the above 
codes and just read the file ksi_cal.
########################################################################################
########################################################################################

```{r}
ksi_cal <- st_read('/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Calgary/Datasets/collisions/Outputs/ksi_cal_cl.geojson')
# View(ksi_cal)
# colnames(ksi_cal)
# nrow(ksi_cal) # 3629

# Using floor_date, change the format of collision_date to be the first day of the month, and create a new column called collision_month
ksi_cal <- ksi_cal %>% 
    mutate(collision_month = floor_date(collision_date, "month"))
# View(ksi_cal)


# Later on, when we want to join the KSI table with the temp and perm coverage tables, we will be joining on Road_UID + collision_month + windows. If there are multiple KSI on the same road segment, in the same month, they will have the same Road_UID and collision_month, and when we do the left join, we will get duplicates of those KSI (one for each perm counter record), which will inflate our coverage counts when we do sum(temp_1M) or sum(perm_1M) because the same KSI will be counted multiple times. By creating a unique KSI ID (e.g., by row number), we can preserve all KSI records without duplication in the join, and then after the join, we can group by that KSI ID to get unique coverage indicators for each KSI.
ksi_cal <- ksi_cal %>% 
  mutate(KSI_ID = row_number())
# View(ksi_cal)

# Reorder to have KSI_ID as the first column
ksi_cal <- ksi_cal %>% 
  select(KSI_ID, everything())
# View(ksi_cal)

# Filter it for relevant columns
# colnames(ksi_tor)
ksi_cal <- ksi_cal %>% 
  select(KSI_ID, Road_UID, collision_month, geometry)
# View(ksi_cal)
```

Create study_start and study_end based on the range of collision_month in ksi_tor (you will need this for expected coverage), and build a complete month spine (every month in study period, even empty ones)

```{r}
study_start <- min(ksi_cal$collision_month)
study_end   <- max(ksi_cal$collision_month)
study_start
study_end
```

Calculate m_j = number of KSIs in segment-month j, then sum(m_j^2) across all segment-months for the variance calculation

```{r}
ksi_cal_seg_month <- ksi_cal %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Road_UID, collision_month) %>%
  summarise(m_j = n(), .groups = "drop")
# View(ksi_cal_seg_month)

# Calculate 
sum_mj_sq <- sum(ksi_cal_seg_month$m_j^2)
cat("Sum of m_j^2 across all segment-months:", sum_mj_sq, "\n")
```

Create time windows for KSI 

Create monthly windows so for 1,2,and 3 months will cover 3, 5, and 7 months respectively (because we want to cover 1 month before and after the collision month, so in total 3 months for 1M window because the month of collision will also be considered)

```{r}
ksi_cal <- ksi_cal %>%
  mutate(
    window_3M_start = collision_month %m-% months(1),
    window_3M_end   = collision_month %m+% months(1),

    window_5M_start = collision_month %m-% months(2),
    window_5M_end   = collision_month %m+% months(2),

    window_7M_start = collision_month %m-% months(3),
    window_7M_end   = collision_month %m+% months(3)
  )
# View(ksi_cal)
```

######################################################################################################
*All the above steps were done to create a new dataset called "perm_cal_final" (will be read as "perm_cal" below), which is the permanent counters in Calgary from 2019 to 2024, with the nearest center line road segment's attributes joined to it. Now we can read this file and continue with the analysis.*
############################################################################################

```{r}
perm_cal <- st_read('/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Calgary/Datasets/counters/permanent/Output/perm_cal_cl_final.geojson')
# View(perm_cal)
# colnames(perm_cal)

# Rename "Address" to "Location" for consistency with temp_cal
perm_cal <- perm_cal %>%
  rename(Location = Address)
```

Create a new dataset including unique permanent counters, with a unique ID for each of them, and a column specifying the type of them

```{r}
# make unique locations
perm_cal_unique <- perm_cal %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(Location, .keep_all = TRUE)
# View(perm_cal_unique)

# Drop Road_UID
perm_cal_unique <- perm_cal_unique %>% 
  select(-Road_UID)

# Create a new ID for each unique counter location
perm_cal_unique <- perm_cal_unique %>%
  mutate(counter_id = row_number())
# View(perm_cal_unique)

# Reorder to have counter_id as the first column
perm_cal_unique <- perm_cal_unique %>% 
  select(counter_id, everything())

# Create a column called counter_type and write permanent for this
perm_cal_unique <- perm_cal_unique %>%
  mutate(counter_type = "permanent")
# View(perm_cal_unique)
# colnames(perm_cal_unique)
```

Create first-count and last-count months for each permanent counter, which will be used to determine if a counter was active during the KSI collision month or within the defined windows (±1M, ±2M, ±3M)

```{r}
perm_cal_unique <- perm_cal_unique %>%
  mutate(
    first_count_month = floor_date(as.Date(first_date), "month"),
    last_count_month  = floor_date(as.Date(last_date),  "month")
  ) %>%
  select(counter_id, Location, counter_type, first_count_month, last_count_month)
# View(perm_cal_unique)
```

*The above chunks of codes were done to create a new dataset called temp_cal_final (will be read as "temp_cal" below), which is the temporary counters in Calgary from 2018/10 to 2024, with the nearest center line road segment's attributes joined to it. Now we can read this file and continue with the analysis. Thus, to save time in running the codes, I commented out the above codes and just read the file temp_cal*

############################################################################################################################################

```{r}
temp_cal <- st_read('/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Calgary/Datasets/temp_cal_cl_final.geojson')
# View(temp_cal)
# colnames(temp_cal)

# Create count_month from count_date as we want to have a column in the format of date, and we don't care about the exact count date, and only want a column in the format of date
temp_cal <- temp_cal %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    count_date = as.Date(count_date),
    month = floor_date(count_date, "month"))

# Keep relevant columns
temp_cal <- temp_cal %>%
  select(Road_UID, Location, month)
# View(temp_cal)
```

Create a new dataset including unique temporary counters, with a unique ID for each of them, and a column specifying the type of them

```{r}

# create a new ID for each unique counter location starting from 21
# nrow(perm_cal_unique) # 20
temp_cal_unique <- temp_cal_unique %>%
  mutate(counter_id = row_number() + 20)
# View(temp_cal_unique)
  
# Reorder columns to have counter_id first and mutate counter_type to be "temporary"
temp_cal_unique <- temp_cal_unique %>%
  mutate(counter_type = "temporary") %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  mutate(
    first_count_month = min(month),
    last_count_month  = max(month)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(counter_id, Location, counter_type, first_count_month, last_count_month)
```

## Merge perm_tor_unique and temp_tor_unique

```{r}
colnames(perm_cal_unique)
colnames(temp_cal_unique)

counter_merge <- bind_rows(perm_cal_unique, temp_cal_unique)
# View(counter_merge)
# colnames(counter_merge)
```

## Create c_P_t and c_R_t (from these codes: COVERAGE_JUL26.Rmd)

Create a dataframe of all months in the study period, which will be used to ensure that we have a row for each month in the final monthly deployment dataset, even if there are no new permanent counters or active counters in that month.

```{r}
months_df <- tibble(
  month = seq(
    floor_date(study_start, "month"),
    floor_date(study_end, "month"),
    by = "1 month"
  )
)
# View(months_df)
```

### Step A. Clean counter data
Create start_month and end_month for each counter, and filter out any counters that don't have a valid counter_id, counter_type, start_month, or end_month, or that are not active during the study period.

```{r}
# View(counter_merge)
counter_clean <- counter_merge %>%
  mutate(
    counter_type = case_when(
      counter_type %in% c("temporary", "rotating") ~ "temporary",
      counter_type == "permanent" ~ "permanent",
      TRUE ~ counter_type
    ),
    start_month = floor_date(as.Date(first_count_month), "month"),
    end_month = if_else(
      is.na(last_count_month),
      floor_date(study_end, "month"),
      floor_date(as.Date(last_count_month), "month")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(counter_id),
    !is.na(counter_type),
    !is.na(start_month),
    start_month <= floor_date(study_end, "month"),
    end_month >= floor_date(study_start, "month")
  )
# View(counter_clean)
```

### Step B. Count new permanent counters installed/first observed each month
Now we can count the number of new permanent counters installed/first observed in each month, and join this with the months_df to ensure that we have a row for each month in the study period, even if there are no new permanent counters in that month.

```{r}
# View(counter_clean)
monthly_new_perm <- months_df %>%
  left_join(
    counter_clean %>%
      filter(counter_type == "permanent") %>%
      distinct(counter_id, start_month) %>%
      count(start_month, name = "new_perm_t"),
    by = c("month" = "start_month")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    new_perm_t = replace_na(new_perm_t, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(month)

# View(monthly_new_perm)
```

### Step C. Expand counters into active counter-months
Here we expand the counter data into a long format where each row represents a counter active in a specific month. This will allow us to count the number of active permanent and temporary counters in each month.

```{r}
# View(counter_clean)

# After running the below code, I got an error message: "'to' must be a "Date" object". To fix this, the type of columns were checked out and it was found that end_month is in the format of POSIXct. Let's change it to Date format and try again.
# str(counter_clean)
counter_clean <- counter_clean %>%
  mutate(
    end_month = as.Date(end_month)
  )
# str(counter_clean)

counter_months <- counter_clean %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    month = list(seq(start_month, end_month, by = "1 month"))
  ) %>%
  unnest(month) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    month >= floor_date(study_start, "month"),
    month <= floor_date(study_end, "month")
  )
# View(counter_months)
```

### Step D. Count active permanent and temporary counters each month
      c_P_t = active permanent counters in month t
      c_R_t = active temporary/rotating counters in month t

```{r}
monthly_active_counters <- counter_months %>%
  group_by(month, counter_type) %>%
  summarise(
    c_t = n_distinct(counter_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    month = months_df$month,
    counter_type = c("permanent", "temporary"),
    fill = list(c_t = 0)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = counter_type,
    values_from = c_t,
    names_prefix = "c_",
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(
    c_P_t = c_permanent,
    c_R_t = c_temporary
  )
# View(monthly_active_counters)
```

### Step E. Final monthly deployment dataset

```{r}
monthly_counter_deployment <- months_df %>%
  left_join(monthly_new_perm, by = "month") %>%
  left_join(monthly_active_counters, by = "month") %>%
  mutate(
    new_perm_t = replace_na(new_perm_t, 0),
    c_P_t = replace_na(c_P_t, 0),
    c_R_t = replace_na(c_R_t, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(month)
# View(monthly_counter_deployment)

# sum of new perm
# sum(monthly_counter_deployment$new_perm_t) # As expected, it was 107.
```

## Observed Coverage 

### Observed Coverage by Permanent Counters

Convert first and last count dates to month-level (floor to first of month)

```{r}
# View(perm_cal)

perm_cal <- perm_cal %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
dplyr::select(Road_UID, Location, first_date, last_date) %>%
  mutate(
    first_date = as.Date(first_date),
    last_date  = as.Date(last_date),
    first_count_month = floor_date(first_date, "month"),
    last_count_month  = floor_date(last_date,  "month")
  )
# View(perm_cal)
```

Distinct covered road segments by permanent counters

```{r}
perm_monthly <- perm_cal %>% 
  distinct()
# View(perm_monthly)
```

Calculate coverage indicators

Same rowwise + any() pattern as temporary counters, but instead of matching a count_month falling inside the window, we check whether the counter's active period [first_count_month, last_count_month] overlaps the window.

```{r}
# View(ksi_cal)

ksi_cal_cov_perm <- ksi_cal %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    perm_3M = as.integer(any(
      perm_monthly$Road_UID == Road_UID &
        perm_monthly$first_count_month <= window_3M_end &
        perm_monthly$last_count_month  >= window_3M_start
    )),
    perm_5M = as.integer(any(
      perm_monthly$Road_UID == Road_UID &
        perm_monthly$first_count_month <= window_5M_end &
        perm_monthly$last_count_month  >= window_5M_start
    )),
    perm_7M = as.integer(any(
      perm_monthly$Road_UID == Road_UID &
        perm_monthly$first_count_month <= window_7M_end &
        perm_monthly$last_count_month  >= window_7M_start
    ))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# View(ksi_cal_cov_perm)
```

Coverage percentages

```{r}
total_ksi <- nrow(ksi_cal)

perm_3M_coverage <- sum(ksi_cal_cov_perm$perm_3M, na.rm = TRUE)
perm_3M_pct <- round(100 * perm_3M_coverage / total_ksi, 2)
perm_3M_CI <- binom.test(perm_3M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int * 100

perm_5M_coverage <- sum(ksi_cal_cov_perm$perm_5M, na.rm = TRUE)
perm_5M_pct <- round(100 * perm_5M_coverage / total_ksi, 2)
perm_5M_CI <- binom.test(perm_5M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int * 100

perm_7M_coverage <- sum(ksi_cal_cov_perm$perm_7M, na.rm = TRUE)
perm_7M_pct <- round(100 * perm_7M_coverage / total_ksi, 2)
perm_7M_CI <- binom.test(perm_7M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int * 100
```

Overall average

```{r}

  Window = c("±1 month (w=3)", "±2 months (w=5)", "±3 months (w=7)"),
  
  Observed_pct = c(perm_3M_pct, perm_5M_pct, perm_7M_pct),
  CI_lower_pct = c(perm_3M_CI[1], perm_5M_CI[1], perm_7M_CI[1]),

)

```

## Expected Coverage

S = total number of road segments in a city, assumed constant over the study period.
KSI_total = total number of KSI
For each month t∈{1,…,T}:
  c_t : number of deployed counters
  g_t : average number of segments covered by a single counter. To calculate g_t: u_t/c_t, where u_t is the unique road segments covered by the counters.


### STEP 1: Calculate KSI_total, g_t, S, unique number of permanent and temporary counters

#### KSI_total

```{r}
KSI_total <- nrow(ksi_cal) #2870
KSI_total
```

#### Calculate g_t for permanent counters 
average number of segments covered by a single permanent counter in month t

To do this, first create a dataset with one row for each permanent counter for each month it was active, then count the number of unique segments covered by those counters in each month, and divide by the number of active counters in that month.

```{r}
# View(perm_tor)
colnames(perm_cal)

perm_cal_monthly <- perm_cal %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    first_month = floor_date(first_date, "month"),
    last_month  = floor_date(last_date, "month")
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    month = list(seq.Date(first_month, last_month, by = "month"))
  ) %>%
  unnest(month) %>%
  select(Road_UID, Location, month) %>%
  distinct()
```

### STEP 2. Logit-transformed CI for a proportion p_hat with SE on the proportion scale

```{r}
logit_ci <- function(p_hat, se_p, conf_level = 0.95) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - conf_level) / 2)
  
  # avoid issues exactly at 0 or 1
  eps <- 1e-8
  p_hat_adj <- min(max(p_hat, eps), 1 - eps)
  
  logit_p  <- qlogis(p_hat_adj)
  se_logit <- se_p / (p_hat_adj * (1 - p_hat_adj))
  
  lower <- plogis(logit_p - z * se_logit)
  upper <- plogis(logit_p + z * se_logit)
  
  c(lower = lower, upper = upper)
}
```

### STEP 4. MONTHLY COVERAGE PROBABILITIES

Permanent counters remain active after installation:
$qP_t = 1 - prod_{m<=t} (1 - gP_m/S)^(new_perm_m)$

Temporary counters: 
$qR_t = 1 - (1 - gR_t/S)^(cR_t)$

```{r}

qP_t_vec <- numeric(Tm)

for (t in 1:Tm) {
  qP_t_vec[t] <- 1 - prod(
    (1 - monthly_input$gP_t[1:t] / S) ^ monthly_input$new_perm_t[1:t]
  )
}

monthly_cov <- monthly_input %>%
  mutate(
    qP_t = qP_t_vec,
    qR_t = 1 - (1 - gR_t / S) ^ c_R_t
  )
```

### STEP 6. COMPUTE WINDOW-SPECIFIC PROBABILITIES BY COUNTER TYPE

Uses real monthly counter deployment from monthly_cov and real KSI segment-month clusters from cluster_tbl.

p_perm_t:probability of permanent-counter coverage at least once within the window.
p_temp_t:probability of temporary-counter coverage at least once within the window.
p_all_t: combined probability of coverage by either permanent or temporary counters.

```{r}
compute_pwt <- function(monthly_cov, w = 3) {
  
  stopifnot(w %in% c(3, 5, 7))
  
  Tm <- nrow(monthly_cov)
  half_w <- (w - 1) / 2
  
  p_perm_t <- numeric(Tm)
  p_temp_t <- numeric(Tm)
  p_all_t  <- numeric(Tm)
  
  for (i in 1:Tm) {
    
    idx <- max(1, i - half_w):min(Tm, i + half_w)
    
    # Permanent counters:
    # Use maximum qP_t in the window because permanent counters accumulate and a larger window can capture counters installed after the collision month.
    p_perm_t[i] <- max(monthly_cov$qP_t[idx], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Temporary counters:
    # Rotating/temporary counters create new opportunities across months.
    p_temp_t[i] <- 1 - prod(1 - monthly_cov$qR_t[idx], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Combined permanent or temporary coverage:
    p_all_t[i] <- 1 - (1 - p_perm_t[i]) * (1 - p_temp_t[i])
  }
  
  monthly_cov %>%
    mutate(
      w = w,
      p_perm_t = p_perm_t,
      p_temp_t = p_temp_t,
      p_all_t  = p_all_t
    )
}
```

### STEP 7. SUMMARISE COVERAGE FOR ONE PROBABILITY COLUMN

Uses real segment-month clusters:
$E[C]   = sum_j m_j * p_t$
$Var(C) = sum_j p_t * (1 - p_t) * m_j^2$

where:
   m_j = number of KSI events in segment-month cluster j
   p_t = expected coverage probability for that month/window/type

```{r}
summarise_one_type <- function(cluster_tbl2, prob_col, type_label, conf_level = 0.95) {
  
  annual_res <- cluster_tbl2 %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      E_C   = sum(m_j * .data[[prob_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Var_C = sum(.data[[prob_col]] * (1 - .data[[prob_col]]) * (m_j^2), na.rm = TRUE),
      K     = sum(m_j, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      p_hat = E_C / K,
      se_p  = sqrt(Var_C) / K,
      coverage_pct = 100 * p_hat,
      ci_obj = list(logit_ci(p_hat, se_p, conf_level)),
      ci_lower = 100 * ci_obj["lower"],
      ci_upper = 100 * ci_obj["upper"],
      type = type_label
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      type,
      year,
      K,
      E_C,
      Var_C,
      coverage_pct,
      ci_lower,
      ci_upper
    )
  
  # Overall pooled estimate
  total_E_C   <- sum(annual_res$E_C, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_Var_C <- sum(annual_res$Var_C, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_K     <- sum(annual_res$K, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  overall_p_hat <- total_E_C / total_K
  overall_se_p  <- sqrt(total_Var_C) / total_K
  overall_ci    <- logit_ci(overall_p_hat, overall_se_p, conf_level)
  
  overall_res <- tibble(
    type = type_label,
    total_K = total_K,
    total_E_C = total_E_C,
    total_Var_C = total_Var_C,
    pooled_coverage_pct = 100 * overall_p_hat,
    ci_lower = 100 * overall_ci["lower"],
    ci_upper = 100 * overall_ci["upper"]
  )
  
  list(
    annual = annual_res,
    overall = overall_res
  )
}

pwt_tbl <- compute_pwt(monthly_cov, w = 3) %>%
  select(month, year, p_perm_t, p_temp_t, p_all_t)

cluster_tbl2 <- cluster_tbl %>%
  left_join(pwt_tbl, by = c("month", "year"))

res_perm <- summarise_one_type(cluster_tbl2, "p_perm_t", "permanent")
res_temp <- summarise_one_type(cluster_tbl2, "p_temp_t", "temporary")
res_all  <- summarise_one_type(cluster_tbl2, "p_all_t",  "combined")
```

### STEP 8. COMPUTE FULL SUMMARY FOR ONE WINDOW

```{r}
compute_coverage_summary <- function(monthly_cov, cluster_tbl, w = 3, conf_level = 0.95) {
  
  # Month-specific probabilities by counter type
  pwt_tbl <- compute_pwt(monthly_cov, w) %>%
    select(month, year, p_perm_t, p_temp_t, p_all_t)
  
  # Attach month-specific probabilities to each real segment-month cluster
  cluster_tbl2 <- cluster_tbl %>%
    left_join(pwt_tbl, by = c("month", "year"))
  
  # Check for unmatched KSI months
  unmatched_months <- cluster_tbl2 %>%
    filter(is.na(p_all_t)) %>%
    distinct(month, year)
  
  if (nrow(unmatched_months) > 0) {
    warning(
      "Some KSI segment-month clusters did not match monthly_cov. ",
      "Check that month formats and study periods are aligned."
    )
    print(unmatched_months)
  }
  
  # Summarise each counter type
  res_perm <- summarise_one_type(cluster_tbl2, "p_perm_t", "permanent", conf_level)
  res_temp <- summarise_one_type(cluster_tbl2, "p_temp_t", "temporary", conf_level)
  res_all  <- summarise_one_type(cluster_tbl2, "p_all_t",  "combined",  conf_level)
  
  annual_all_types <- bind_rows(
    res_perm$annual,
    res_temp$annual,
    res_all$annual
  ) %>%
    arrange(type, year)
  
  overall_all_types <- bind_rows(
    res_perm$overall,
    res_temp$overall,
    res_all$overall
  ) %>%
    mutate(w = w) %>%
    select(w, everything())
  
  list(
    monthly_pwt = pwt_tbl,
    cluster_table = cluster_tbl2,
    annual_by_type = annual_all_types,
    overall_by_type = overall_all_types,
    unmatched_months = unmatched_months
  )
}
```

### Counter density by road class

```{r}
# Import
perm_cal_monthly <- read_csv('/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Calgary/Datasets/perm_cal_monthly.csv')
temp_cal_monthly <- read_csv('/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Calgary/Datasets/temp_cal_monthly.csv')

# ── 1. Extract Full Dynamic Study Range ───────────────────────────────────────
all_months_cal <- c(perm_cal_monthly$month, temp_cal_monthly$month)
min_study_date_cal <- min(all_months_cal, na.rm = TRUE)
max_study_date_cal <- max(all_months_cal, na.rm = TRUE)
total_study_months_cal <- length(seq.Date(as.Date(min_study_date_cal),
                                           as.Date(max_study_date_cal),
                                           by = "month"))

# ── 2. Combine and Deduplicate Active Months ──────────────────────────────────
combined_active_months_cal <- bind_rows(
  perm_cal_monthly %>% dplyr::select(Road_UID, month),
  temp_cal_monthly %>% dplyr::select(Road_UID, month)
) %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(month)) %>%
  distinct(Road_UID, month)

# Join centreline to assign road class
combined_active_cl_cal <- combined_active_months_cal %>%
  left_join(
    cl_cal_RoadClass %>% dplyr::select(Road_UID, road_class),
    by = "Road_UID"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(road_class))

# ── 3. Calculate Capacity per Road Class ──────────────────────────────────────
cl_class_capacity_cal <- cl_cal_RoadClass %>%
  filter(!is.na(road_class)) %>%
  group_by(road_class) %>%
  summarise(
    total_segments = n_distinct(Road_UID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_possible_road_months = total_segments * total_study_months_cal
  )

# ── 4. Compute Coverage Columns ───────────────────────────────────────────────
counter_events_by_class_cal <- combined_active_cl_cal %>%
  group_by(road_class) %>%
  summarise(
    total_monitored_road_months = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(cl_class_capacity_cal, by = "road_class") %>%
  replace_na(list(total_monitored_road_months = 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_combined_network_coverage = round(
      100 * total_monitored_road_months / total_possible_road_months, 2
    ),
    pct_counter_activity = round(
      100 * total_monitored_road_months / sum(total_monitored_road_months), 2
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_combined_network_coverage))

# View(counter_events_by_class_cal)

# Export this
write.csv(counter_events_by_class_cal, '/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Calgary/Datasets/road class/Outputs/counter_events_by_class_cal.csv')
```

### Observed Coverage

```{r}
obs_by_class <- ksi_cal_cov_cl %>%
  group_by(road_class) %>%
  summarise(
    total_KSI    = n(),

    n_covered_3M = sum(cov_any_3M, na.rm = TRUE),
    cov_3M_pct   = round(100 * n_covered_3M / total_KSI, 2),
    cov_3M_CI_lo = round(binom.test(n_covered_3M, total_KSI)$conf.int[1] * 100, 2),
    cov_3M_CI_hi = round(binom.test(n_covered_3M, total_KSI)$conf.int[2] * 100, 2),

    n_covered_5M = sum(cov_any_5M, na.rm = TRUE),
    cov_5M_pct   = round(100 * n_covered_5M / total_KSI, 2),
    cov_5M_CI_lo = round(binom.test(n_covered_5M, total_KSI)$conf.int[1] * 100, 2),
    cov_5M_CI_hi = round(binom.test(n_covered_5M, total_KSI)$conf.int[2] * 100, 2),

    n_covered_7M = sum(cov_any_7M, na.rm = TRUE),
    cov_7M_pct   = round(100 * n_covered_7M / total_KSI, 2),
    cov_7M_CI_lo = round(binom.test(n_covered_7M, total_KSI)$conf.int[1] * 100, 2),
    cov_7M_CI_hi = round(binom.test(n_covered_7M, total_KSI)$conf.int[2] * 100, 2),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_KSI))
```

```{r}
cluster_tbl_class <- cluster_tbl %>%
  left_join(cl_cal_RoadClass,
            by = c("segment_id" = "Road_UID")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(road_class))

# Then for each road class separately
road_classes <- unique(cluster_tbl_class$road_class)

exp_by_class_list <- lapply(road_classes, function(rc) {
  
  # Road-class-specific S
  S_class <- cl_cal_RoadClass %>%
    filter(road_class == rc) %>%
    pull(Road_UID) %>%
    n_distinct()
  
  # Road-class-specific g_t
  g_t_perm_rc <- g_t_perm_class %>%
    filter(road_class == rc) %>%
    pull(g_t_perm)
  
  g_t_temp_rc <- g_t_temp_class %>%
    filter(road_class == rc) %>%
    pull(g_t_temp)
  
  # Handle road classes with no permanent counters
  if (length(g_t_perm_rc) == 0) g_t_perm_rc <- 0
  if (length(g_t_temp_rc) == 0) g_t_temp_rc <- 0

  # Road-class-specific c_P_t and c_R_t per month
  c_P_class <- covered_per_month_perm_class %>%
    filter(road_class == rc) %>%
    dplyr::select(month, c_P_class_t = c_t)

  c_R_class <- covered_per_month_temp_class %>%
    filter(road_class == rc) %>%
    dplyr::select(month, c_R_class_t = c_t)

  # Join to monthly_input
  monthly_input_class <- monthly_input %>%
    left_join(c_P_class, by = "month") %>%
    left_join(c_R_class, by = "month") %>%
    mutate(
      c_P_class_t = replace_na(c_P_class_t, 0),
      c_R_class_t = replace_na(c_R_class_t, 0),
      gP_t = g_t_perm_rc,
      gR_t = g_t_temp_rc
    )

  # Cumulative product for permanent
  Tm <- nrow(monthly_input_class)
  qP_t_vec <- numeric(Tm)
  for (t in 1:Tm) {
    qP_t_vec[t] <- 1 - prod(
      (1 - monthly_input_class$gP_t[1:t] / S_class) ^
        monthly_input_class$new_perm_t[1:t]
    )
  }

  monthly_cov_class <- monthly_input_class %>%
    mutate(
      qP_t = qP_t_vec,
      qR_t = 1 - (1 - gR_t / S_class) ^ c_R_class_t
    )

  cluster_rc <- cluster_tbl_class %>% filter(road_class == rc)

  res3 <- compute_coverage_summary(monthly_cov_class, cluster_rc, w = 3)
  res5 <- compute_coverage_summary(monthly_cov_class, cluster_rc, w = 5)
  res7 <- compute_coverage_summary(monthly_cov_class, cluster_rc, w = 7)

  bind_rows(
    res3$overall_by_type,
    res5$overall_by_type,
    res7$overall_by_type
  ) %>%
    mutate(road_class = rc)
})

# ── Bind all road class results ───────────────────────────────────────────────
exp_by_class <- bind_rows(exp_by_class_list)

# ── Filter to combined counter type and format ────────────────────────────────
exp_by_class_clean <- exp_by_class %>%
  filter(type == "combined") %>%
  mutate(
    Window = case_when(
      w == 3 ~ "±1 month (w=3)",
      w == 5 ~ "±2 months (w=5)",
      w == 7 ~ "±3 months (w=7)"
    ),
    exp_pct   = round(pooled_coverage_pct, 2),
    exp_CI_lo = round(ci_lower, 2),
    exp_CI_hi = round(ci_upper, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(road_class, Window, exp_pct, exp_CI_lo, exp_CI_hi)

write_csv(exp_by_class_clean, '/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Calgary/Datasets/road class/Outputs/exp_by_class.csv')
```
